newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: First Capital in S$146 mln bond issue.
newsitem.headline: First Capital in S$146 mln bond issue.

text.p: Property company First Capital Corp Ltd said on Wednesday its wholly-owned unit Century Square Development Pte Ltd had proposed the issue of Singapore $146 million worth of five percent secured fixed rate bonds due 2002.
First Capital said in a statement Century Square had appointed Oversea-Chinese Banking Corp Ltd (OCBC) as the manager and paying agent of the issue.
The bonds would be entirely subscribed by OCBC on a bought deal basis and issued at par in bearer form in the denomination of S$250,000 each.
The bonds would be redeemmed in full at par five years from the date of issue and would bear an interest rate of five percent per annum, it said.
The bonds would be secured in several ways including by a mortgage over Century Square Shopping Centre and a debenture over Century Square's assets.
The proceeds of the issue would be used to refinance existing credit facilities of Century Square and to finance property development activities in Singapore undertaken by the First Capital group.
The statement gave no other details.
